name: drakuseth_fdn_four_to_one_target_three_to_two_others
note: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames: 'Whenever Drakuseth attacks, Drakuseth deals 4 damage to any target and 3 damage to each of up to two other targets.' The trigger designates its two instances of 'target' in turn (CR 603.3d, 601.2c): OppBear for the 4, then P1 and OppGiant for the 3 (other targets: never OppBear again, CR 115.3). OppBear dies, OppGiant is dealt 3, P1 loses 3, then 7 combat damage from the unblocked flier. Red before 2026-11-13 (with this record): the trigger raised 'per-slot designation is /06 arc 3'.
